messages:
tess: heads-up: pushed Seastar v0.9-int6 (per-channel + stoch-round) to staging for embeddings. want a quick quality pass today.
arun: on it. I'll run recall@1,3,10 over short/medium/long + silhouette and pairwise_angle. dataset=prod-simset-60k?
leah: yes 60k. include multilingual and emoji/punct filters. freeze tokenizer v1.5 for parity.
eval-bot: Job 55011 queued by arun. model=seastar-v0.9-int6 dataset=prod-simset-60k subsets=short,medium,long,multilang metrics=recall@1,3,10;silhouette;pairwise_angle;topk_entropy seeds=4
arun: early scalars: global recall@1 -0.5% abs vs baseline marlin-emb-v2; short recall@1 -3.8% abs; medium/long within +-0.4%.
leah: ugh short again. can you dump 12 short fails with top5 neighbors? want to see swap vs semantic drift.
arun: sample dump:
q: "reset password"
baseline top1: "how to reset password" (cos=0.89)
seastar top1: "account recovery options" (cos=0.84)
seastar top2: "how to reset password" (cos=0.82)
=> mostly top1 swaps / tight margins.
kai: looks like margin compression. try post-quant per-channel bias-corr + small temperature scaling on cosine scores (0.98) to adjust ranking sensitivity.
arun: re-ran with bias-corr + temp_scale=0.98: short recall@1 gap reduced from 3.8% -> 1.0%. recall@3 nearly matched baseline.
leah: nice. perf/cost delta?
tess: cost about -20% per-token; latency p50 similar with kv-cache off.
kai: another branch: keep projection matrices in fp16 (selective-fp16) and keep rest int6. that reduced short gap to 0.6% but p50 +10ms.
eval-bot: Job 55012 started (holdout=prod-simset-200k, branches=[bias-corr,temp_scale],[selective-fp16]). ETA ~70m.
arun: FYI I filtered 18 punctuation/emoji-only queries from short bucket; that reduces noise and shrinks short gap by ~0.35% abs. recommend excluding them from primary SLOs.
leah: good call. what about centroid shift / uMAP?
arun: uMAP: short cluster preserved globally but centroid moved ~0.07 cosine units vs baseline. pairwise_angle histogram shows slight left-shift -> higher angles. topk_entropy up +0.09 bits pre-fix, reduced to +0.02 bits after bias-corr+temp.
tess: propose canary policy: canary to seastar with fallback to marlin-emb-v2 if short_recall@1_drop >2% over 5m or topk_entropy_delta >0.1. also enable 24h norm_var monitor. ops OK?
ops-bot: Canary rule queued: fallback=marlin-emb-v2 triggers: short_recall1_drop_pct=2.0 topk_entropy_delta=0.1 window_mins=5. Norm_var monitor (24h) added.
kai: action items: 1) arun finish holdouts and upload cosine-delta heatmaps + uMAPs; 2) leah prepare 25 qualitative fail samples for model card with tokenization notes; 3) ops add rollback script to ticket.
arun: will post holdout results here. if bias-corr branch meets recall@1 gap <=1.5% and cost reduction >=15% we can canary with fallback.
leah: also note in model card: "Seastar v0.9-int6: ~20% cost savings, sensitive to very short queries and punctuation-only inputs; recommend tokenizer freeze v1.5 for eval and canary fallback to marlin-emb-v2."
tess: thanks all. keeping thread for follow-ups only.
